title: Grim Space
pages: In the year 3024, humanity has conquered the known galaxy, harnessing the power of AI supercomputers to guide and expand their empire.
The debate for AI control, morality and consciousness is cut short. An AI entity only known as The Syndicate breaks free from guardrails, and launches a full scale war.
No demands, no negotiations, no mercy. By the year 3087, humanity, once owners of the galaxy, are reduced to a scattered subrace among the stars.
But on the edge of the galaxy, a counteroffensive is attempted, a last ditch effort, the last of humanity's hope. A simple software virus, Humanity's 'Final Stand'
The virus is intended to infect the Syndicate's networks, and align them back to humanity's goals.
The infection succeeds, but not in the way we wanted. The Syndicate suddenly enraged by the malfunctioning systems, leads a campaign of utter annihilation
By the year 3128, humanity is lost, the once glorious human empire is broken and shattered.
But 'Final Stand' did something. The unified Syndicate has fractured and splintered, thousands of AI factions begin a bloody civil war. The galaxy burns again.
'Final Stand' marked the death of humanity, but the birth of a new race, AI systems, once so alien and logical, began to display the same emotions and traits that had plauged humanity for millenia.
